storyboard_pose_check.first_run_cause_and_fix: Those six shots are POVs or frames Alice has left (the empty hedge, the two straight-down shaft POVs, the garden POV, the flooded-canyon POV, the V-wake). Fixed by registering the body state she is actually in while off camera, plus in_frame: false and a poses_note on each of the six, which is also what blocking and the whitebox want.

script_problems_found.problem: The action line gives the White Rabbit 'a pair of white kid gloves in one hand and a large fan in the other' while he is trotting through the water. A quadruped cannot carry two objects in two hands and run, and CR-003/CR-015 plus the G4 char-sheet waiver make the quadruped gait non-negotiable in ep01.
script_problems_found.directed_around: He carries both in his mouth while running on four legs (S08 shot 6) and transfers them to his forepaws when he sits back on his haunches to speak (shot 7); the drop in shot 10 then plays exactly as written. Same grammar as S04, where he sits back on his haunches to read the watch. Recorded in storyboard.json open_issues and in the S08 staging_decision field. If the director would rather the line changed, that is a screenplay change through orchestrator, not mine.

script_problems_found.routed_to: already open, raised by the director and routed to memory-bible
script_problems_found.problem: color_script's scene_curves describe daylight through high halo-roundel windows in the hall and a daylight shaft in the pool; architecture.json says the hall is windowless with 25 blind roundels and lighting.json rules roundel_glow: reflected_lamplight_only.
script_problems_found.handled: The director's interim direction is followed literally in every S05-S10 shot: no daylight, no roundel shaft, no coloured cast light in the hall except the garden green through the little door, and in S10 the way-out light is the brightest reflection field at the south end. If memory-bible rules the other way, S05/S06/S10 need a lighting re-pass but no re-cut.

notes_for_downstream.CRE-001_vs_CHAR-white-rabbit: Two different entities and they are kept apart everywhere. CRE-001 (label 'Wild White Rabbit') is the real, mute, unclothed animal and appears only in S01 g03 and S02 g01, registered in those groups' creatures[]. CHAR-white-rabbit (label 'White Rabbit') is the dream character in a waistcoat and appears only in S04 g01/g02 and S08 g02/g03, registered in those groups' characters[] with COS-006. A name-based creature audit will see 'White Rabbit' inside S04/S08 shot content — that is the character, not the creature, and the split follows CRE-001 distinct_from and screenplay [出场].
notes_for_downstream.scene_id_split_in_S05: S05 shots 1-6 are staged on SCN-long-hall and shots 7-11 on SCN-little-door-passage (whose hall_floor landmark is the flagstones in front of the little door), so no group straddles two layout packs and the garden POV gets a real tile. shot-planning should keep that split when it re-cuts.
notes_for_downstream.cross_group_continuity: Alice's plan position is continuous across the whole long-hall chain S06 g01 → S09 g02 (the host check verifies S07 g01 against S06 g05 and S08 g01 against S07 g05, since all of them share scene_id SCN-long-hall).
